units.source_text: 源氏回想起了旧日之事，觉得昔年谪居远浦时凄惨之状，历历如在目前，而无人可与共话当时之事。

en.t: Genji recalled the events of long ago and felt that the misery of his former exile on that distant shore stood vividly before his eyes, yet there was no one with whom he could speak of those days.

units.source_text: 他便惦记那位现已致仕的太政大臣。

en.t: He therefore found himself thinking of the Grand Minister, who had now retired from office.

units.source_text: 感慨之余，吟成一诗，走到后面去送交老尼姑所乘的车子中。

en.t: Moved by emotion, he composed a poem, went around to the rear, and sent it into the carriage in which the old nun was riding.
